title: Astros+ 2026 — Signals: Strengths and Opportunities
description: Performance analysis of Astros+ in NACL Div A, Spring and Summer 2026.

panels.title: Bowling: level with the semi-finalists
panels.description: Runs conceded per over: ours vs the average of the 4 semi-finalists.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Economy ' || value || '  vs  ' || top4_avg FROM cricket.team_ranks
WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND season = 'Summer 2026' AND metric = 'Economy'

panels.title: Batting: well behind others
panels.description: Runs scored per over: ours vs the average of the 4 semi-finalists.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Run rate ' || value || '  vs  ' || top4_avg FROM cricket.team_ranks
WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND season = 'Summer 2026' AND metric = 'Run rate'

panels.title: Losses that included a batting collapse
panels.description: Collapse = 3 or more wickets inside 3 overs, before the last 3 overs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(c.match_id) || ' of ' || count(*) FROM cricket.match_log l
LEFT JOIN cricket.collapses c ON c.match_id = l.match_id AND c.team = l.team
WHERE l.team = 'Astros+' AND l.season = 'Summer 2026' AND l.result = 'Lost'

panels.title: Score that wins batting first
panels.description: Median first-innings score of Div A teams that batted first and won, vs our average score.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY runs)::int || '  ·  we average ' ||
       (SELECT round(avg_score)::int FROM cricket.team_summary WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND season = 'Summer 2026')
FROM cricket.team_innings WHERE season = 'Summer 2026' AND batted_first AND won

panels.title: 1 · The game is decided by over 15
Our score, over by over: wins vs losses
panels.description: Average score at the end of each over. The lines split after the powerplay and are 28 runs apart by over 15.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.over_no AS "Over",
       round(avg(o.cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE o.team = 'Astros+' AND o.result = 'Won'), 1)  AS "Our wins",
       round(avg(o.cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE o.team = 'Astros+' AND o.result = 'Lost'), 1) AS "Our losses",
       round(avg(o.cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE s.top4), 1)                                  AS "Semi-finalists (all games)"
FROM cricket.innings_overs o
JOIN cricket.team_summary s ON s.season = o.season AND s.team = o.team
WHERE o.season = 'Summer 2026'
GROUP BY o.over_no ORDER BY o.over_no

panels.title: Checkpoints: wins vs losses (Summer)

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (
    SELECT result, match_id,
           max(cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE over_no = 6)  AS r6,  max(cum_wickets) FILTER (WHERE over_no = 6)  AS w6,
           max(cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE over_no = 15) AS r15, max(cum_wickets) FILTER (WHERE over_no = 15) AS w15,
           max(final_runs) AS fr, max(dots_faced) * 100.0 / max(legal_balls) AS dots
    FROM cricket.innings_overs WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND season = 'Summer 2026' GROUP BY result, match_id
)
SELECT 'After 6 overs' AS "Checkpoint",
       round(avg(r6) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Won')) || ' for ' || round(avg(w6) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Won')) AS "Our wins",
       round(avg(r6) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Lost')) || ' for ' || round(avg(w6) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Lost')) AS "Our losses", 1 AS o FROM g
UNION ALL
SELECT 'After 15 overs',
       round(avg(r15) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Won')) || ' for ' || round(avg(w15) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Won')),
       round(avg(r15) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Lost')) || ' for ' || round(avg(w15) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Lost')), 2 FROM g
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Final score', round(avg(fr) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Won'))::text, round(avg(fr) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Lost'))::text, 3 FROM g
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Dot balls faced', round(avg(dots) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Won')) || '%', round(avg(dots) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Lost')) || '%', 4 FROM g
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Games', count(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Won')::text, count(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'Lost')::text, 5 FROM g
ORDER BY o

panels.title: 2 · Where we lose ground to the semi-finalists
Batting: runs short of the semi-finalists, per innings
panels.description: Our run rate minus the semi-finalists' in each phase, times the overs in that phase. About 26 runs over a full innings.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(p.phase) || CASE p.phase WHEN 'powerplay' THEN ' (6 overs)' WHEN 'middle' THEN ' (9 overs)' ELSE ' (5 overs)' END AS phase,
       round((p.run_rate - avg(q.run_rate) FILTER (WHERE s.top4))
             * CASE p.phase WHEN 'powerplay' THEN 6 WHEN 'middle' THEN 9 ELSE 5 END, 1) AS "Runs vs semi-finalists"
FROM cricket.team_phase p
JOIN cricket.team_phase q ON q.season = p.season AND q.side = p.side AND q.phase = p.phase
JOIN cricket.team_summary s ON s.season = q.season AND s.team = q.team
WHERE p.team = 'Astros+' AND p.side = 'batting' AND p.season = 'Summer 2026'
GROUP BY p.phase, p.phase_order, p.run_rate ORDER BY p.phase_order

panels.title: Batting: wickets lost per innings, by phase
panels.description: Lower is better. The middle overs are where we lose wickets faster than the semi-finalists.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(p.phase) || CASE p.phase WHEN 'powerplay' THEN ' (1-6)' WHEN 'middle' THEN ' (7-15)' ELSE ' (16-20)' END AS phase,
       p.wickets_per_innings AS "Astros+",
       round(avg(q.wickets_per_innings) FILTER (WHERE s.top4), 2) AS "Semi-finalists"
FROM cricket.team_phase p
JOIN cricket.team_phase q ON q.season = p.season AND q.side = p.side AND q.phase = p.phase
JOIN cricket.team_summary s ON s.season = q.season AND s.team = q.team
WHERE p.team = 'Astros+' AND p.side = 'batting' AND p.season = 'Summer 2026'
GROUP BY p.phase, p.phase_order, p.wickets_per_innings ORDER BY p.phase_order

panels.title: Bowling: runs conceded per over, by phase
panels.description: Lower is better. Our middle overs are tighter than the semi-finalists'; the powerplay is where we leak.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(p.phase) || CASE p.phase WHEN 'powerplay' THEN ' (1-6)' WHEN 'middle' THEN ' (7-15)' ELSE ' (16-20)' END AS phase,
       p.run_rate AS "Astros+",
       round(avg(q.run_rate) FILTER (WHERE s.top4), 2) AS "Semi-finalists"
FROM cricket.team_phase p
JOIN cricket.team_phase q ON q.season = p.season AND q.side = p.side AND q.phase = p.phase
JOIN cricket.team_summary s ON s.season = q.season AND s.team = q.team
WHERE p.team = 'Astros+' AND p.side = 'bowling' AND p.season = 'Summer 2026'
GROUP BY p.phase, p.phase_order, p.run_rate ORDER BY p.phase_order

panels.title: 3 · Us vs the rest of Div A: where we are better, where we are worse
Summer 2026: how we compare with the division average
panels.description: Percentage difference from the Div A average for each measure, flipped so that positive always means better for us (e.g. fewer dot balls faced counts as positive).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT metric AS "Metric",
       round(100.0 * CASE WHEN higher_is_better THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * (value - league_avg) / abs(league_avg), 1)
           AS "Better (+) or worse (−) than the division average"
FROM cricket.team_ranks
WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND season = 'Summer 2026' AND metric NOT IN ('Net run rate', 'Average score')
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Analysis: performance relative to the division

options.content:
**Methodology.** Each bar shows Astros+ performance relative to the Division A average, expressed as a percentage. Values are normalised so that a positive figure (green) always indicates above-average performance and a negative figure (red) indicates below-average performance.

**Areas of strength**
- **Bowling effectiveness:** wicket-taking (+8%) and dot-ball percentage (+3%) both exceed the division average.
- **Discipline in the field:** catching (+6%) and control of wides (+5%) are above average.

**Areas for improvement**
- **Squad continuity:** 26 batters were used during the season, against a division average of 21.
- **Run-outs effected:** 0.33 per match, against a division average of 0.61.
- **Batting tempo:** boundary frequency is below average and dot-ball percentage is above average. Six-hitting is the one exception, marginally above average.

**Summary.** Astros+ currently perform in line with an average Division A side. The semi-finalists are differentiated from the division primarily by their batting.

panels.title: 4 · The league changed between Spring and Summer. Did we?
Change from Spring to Summer, %
panels.description: How much each measure moved between the two seasons, for the whole division and for us.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
    SELECT metric AS m, sort_order AS o,
           max(league_avg) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Spring 2026') AS l0, max(league_avg) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Summer 2026') AS l1,
           max(value) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Spring 2026' AND team = 'Astros+') AS u0,
           max(value) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Summer 2026' AND team = 'Astros+') AS u1
    FROM cricket.team_ranks
    WHERE metric IN ('Run rate', 'Sixes per innings', 'Dot balls faced %', 'Economy')
    GROUP BY metric, sort_order
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Boundaries per over', 3,
           6.0 / max(league_avg) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Spring 2026'), 6.0 / max(league_avg) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Summer 2026'),
           6.0 / max(value) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Spring 2026' AND team = 'Astros+'),
           6.0 / max(value) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Summer 2026' AND team = 'Astros+')
    FROM cricket.team_ranks WHERE metric = 'Balls per boundary'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Run rate, ' || phase, 20 + phase_order,
           max(league_avg_run_rate) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Spring 2026'), max(league_avg_run_rate) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Summer 2026'),
           max(run_rate) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Spring 2026' AND team = 'Astros+'),
           max(run_rate) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Summer 2026' AND team = 'Astros+')
    FROM cricket.team_phase WHERE side = 'batting' GROUP BY phase, phase_order
)
SELECT replace(replace(m, 'Economy', 'Runs conceded per over (bowling)'), 'Run rate', 'Run rate') AS "Measure",
       round(100 * (l1 - l0) / l0) AS "Division",
       round(100 * (u1 - u0) / u0) AS "Astros+"
FROM r ORDER BY o

panels.title: Analysis: change between seasons

options.content:
**Methodology.** Each pair of bars shows the percentage change in a measure between the Spring and Summer seasons, for the division as a whole (grey) and for Astros+ (blue).

**Division-wide trend**
- Boundary frequency increased by 65% and six-hitting by 61%.
- Scoring rates rose in every phase of the innings, with an overall increase of 28%.

**Astros+ response**
- Run rate and boundary frequency remained broadly unchanged.
- Dot-ball percentage increased by 6%, while the division recorded a 6% reduction.
- Scoring in the death overs declined by 17%.

**Bowling.** Astros+ adapted more effectively than the division with the ball: runs conceded per over rose by 10%, compared with 28% across the division. This underpins the improvement in the economy ranking from 15th to 8th.

panels.title: 5 · What to fix
Possible checkpoints for future games

options.content:
### Possible checkpoints

| Checkpoint | In our wins | In our losses | **Where we want to be** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Score after 6 overs | 44 for 1 | 32 for 2 | **45+ with 1 down or fewer** |
| Wickets down after 15 overs | 5 | 7 | **5 or fewer** — the single biggest difference |
| Total batting first | 158 average | 102 average | **160+** (Div A teams that won batting first scored a median of 172) |

**And keep doing:** bowl the middle overs the way we do (economy 6.73, better than the semi-finalists' 7.33), and take wickets (8.7 a match, 4th of 16).

panels.title: Insights

options.content:
## Our bowling is semi-final standard. We lose when the batting falls apart between overs 7 and 15.

In our **4 Summer losses** we were **84 for 7 after 15 overs**; in our **5 wins**, **112 for 5**. Every loss included a batting collapse (3+ wickets in 3 overs).
Meanwhile the whole division learned to score faster between Spring and Summer (run rate **+28%**). **Our batting stayed where it was (−1%).**

panels.title: Detail · results, both seasons
Season results

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(match_date, 'Dy DD Mon') AS "Date", stage AS "Stage", opponent AS "Opponent", batting_order AS "Innings",
       score_for AS "Our score", score_against AS "Their score", result AS "Result", margin AS "Margin"
FROM cricket.match_log WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND season = 'Summer 2026' ORDER BY match_date

panels.title: Spring 2026 results

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(match_date, 'DD Mon') AS "Date", stage AS "Stage", opponent AS "Opponent",
       score_for AS "Our score", score_against AS "Their score", result AS "Result", margin AS "Margin"
FROM cricket.match_log WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND season = 'Spring 2026' ORDER BY match_date

panels.title: Detail · batting collapse log
Incident log: batting collapses
panels.description: 3 or more wickets inside any 3-over window, before the last 3 overs (overs 18-20 are treated as deliberate slogging). One row per innings: the worst window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(match_date, 'DD Mon') AS "Date", season AS "Season", opponent AS "Opponent",
       overs AS "Overs", wickets_in_window AS "Wickets", score_change AS "Score change",
       final_score AS "Final score", result AS "Result"
FROM cricket.collapses WHERE team = 'Astros+' ORDER BY match_date DESC

panels.title: Detail · full rank table, Summer 2026 vs the semi-finalists
Where Astros+ ranks (out of 16) vs the semi-finalists
panels.description: Rank 1 = best in Div A for that metric. Green = top 5, red = bottom 5.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.category AS "Area", r.metric AS "Metric", r.value AS "Astros+", r.rank AS "Rank",
       r.top4_avg AS "Semi-finalists avg",
       r.league_avg AS "League avg", r.best_team || ' (' || r.best_value || ')' AS "Best in Div A"
FROM cricket.team_ranks r
WHERE r.team = 'Astros+' AND r.season = 'Summer 2026'
ORDER BY r.sort_order

panels.title: Detail · rank changes, Spring vs Summer
Astros+ rank by metric: Spring 2026 vs Summer 2026
panels.description: Rank out of the division in each season (1 = best). 'Places moved' is positive when the rank improved.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.category AS "Area", o.metric AS "Metric",
       o.value AS "Spring", o.rank AS "Spring rank",
       n.value AS "Summer", n.rank AS "Summer rank",
       o.rank - n.rank AS "Places moved",
       n.top4_avg AS "Top 4 avg, Summer"
FROM cricket.team_ranks o JOIN cricket.team_ranks n USING (team, metric)
WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND o.season = 'Spring 2026' AND n.season = 'Summer 2026'
ORDER BY o.sort_order
